# RPM test databases

`specs/` contains two original, empty-payload RPM specs written for Ravel's
integration tests. The base package provides `ravel-fixture-virtual = 1.0`;
the consumer requires `ravel-fixture-virtual >= 1.0`.

The SQLite database in this fixture was created by building both specs with
`rpmbuild` in Fedora 42 and installing the resulting RPMs into an isolated
`rpm --dbpath` directory. The NDB fixture at `../rpm-ndb-basic/` contains the
same two packages after `rpmdb --rebuilddb --define '_db_backend ndb'`.
The Berkeley DB fixture at `../rpm-bdb-basic/` was generated by installing
those same RPMs into an isolated `rpm --dbpath` directory in CentOS 7.
No operating system package database or application source was copied into
these fixtures.
